description: Source code for a simple, persistent key-value store implementation (Diskv) in Go, including methods for reading, writing, importing, deleting, and managing cache and filesystem storage.

classes.name: Diskv
classes.description: Main struct implementing the key-value store with filesystem and cache management.

classes.name: TransformFunction
classes.description: Type for functions transforming keys into path segments.

classes.name: closingReader
classes.description: Reader that automatically closes the underlying ReadCloser at EOF.

classes.name: siphon
classes.description: Reader that copies data to cache upon EOF.

classes.name: nopWriteCloser
classes.description: Wrapper for io.Writer to provide a no-op Close method.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Constructor for Diskv, initializes with options.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Synchronously writes key-value pair to disk.

methods.name: WriteStream
methods.description: Writes data from io.Reader to disk under a key, with optional sync.

methods.name: Import
methods.description: Imports a file into the store under a specified key, optionally moving the source file.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads value for a key, returning all data.

methods.name: ReadStream
methods.description: Returns an io.ReadCloser for the value, with cache and decompression handling.

methods.name: Erase
methods.description: Deletes a key from cache and filesystem.

methods.name: EraseAll
methods.description: Deletes all data from cache and filesystem.

methods.name: Keys
methods.description: Returns a channel of all keys.

methods.name: KeysPrefix
methods.description: Returns a channel of keys with a specific prefix.
